notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Bug fixed

 Fixed some translation issues
 Fixed a bug that may cause incorrectly reflected damage when wearing Thorn Armor, even if the attack missed
 Fixed a bug that may cause the player would still die after using a skill that reduced health and then triggered life steal
 Fixed a bug that may cause all monsters in the last wave would be killed when player using certain skills

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
In this version, we:

Fixed a bug that may cause language settings won't save when you exit.
Fixed some bugs that may cause monsters to freeze on the battleground.
Fixed some bugs that may cause skills can not take effect properly.


If you encounter any bugs or troubles or just want to share your opinions, use the Steam forums or join 2P Game’s Discord server. (On Strategy Games Group)
